management.basicsHint: Give your map a clear name so you can find it in Builder.
management.contentHint: Add locations, connect geographic data, or combine both. Switching tabs keeps your entries.
management.locationsHint: Mark places without a data source, such as the town hall or the library. Search the address: each result you pick is added as a location and the starting area adjusts.
management.reviewHint: Preview before saving. Changes stay in draft until you publish your website.
management.contentSummary: {locations, plural, one {# location} other {# locations}} · {layers, plural, one {# data layer} other {# data layers}}
management.title: Maps
management.pageDescription: Create a location map or connect geographic data, then add it to a page in Builder.
management.listDescription: One map per purpose: civic buildings, local services, or live measurements.
management.name: Name
management.deleteDescription: The map configuration is removed. This cannot be undone.
management.deleteInUse: A page still shows this map. Remove it from the pages and publish before deleting it.
management.limitReached: This website has reached its limit of maps. Delete a map you no longer need first.
management.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
management.deleteFailed: The map could not be deleted. Please try again.
management.empty: Start with your own locations or connect geographic data.
management.leaveDescription: Your unsaved map settings will be lost.
management.datasetsTruncated: Only some compatible datasets are shown. Narrow your dataset collection if a dataset is missing.
management.layersDescription: Each layer uses a GeoFeature dataset from this website. Labels appear in the legend.
management.noDatasets: Connect and map a geographic dataset in Data sources first.
management.backgroundVectorHint: The platform draws the map itself as a vector graphic. Your own areas form the background, for example districts as a second layer. Visitors load nothing from third parties, and the map also appears without JavaScript.
management.backgroundStreetsHint: The street background loads as map tiles from Mapbox, so visitors request data from Mapbox. If loading fails, the page shows the vector map.
management.backgroundSetting: The background is not chosen per map: operations set it for the whole installation. For privacy, the street map is off. It is switched on only with a Mapbox token and NEXT_PUBLIC_EXTERNAL_MAPS_ALLOWED=true, after the lawful basis is documented or a consent step is in place.
management.pointStyleVectorHint: On the vector map every location appears as the same dot; the heatmap shows concentrations as a glow. Grouping, circle sizes, colours and the legend take effect only on the street map.
management.pointStyleStreetsHint: Markers show every location, circles grow with a value, groups combine nearby locations, the heatmap shows concentrations.
management.featureLimitHint: Shared across all layers. When an area is too dense, a warning asks visitors to zoom in.
management.areaHint: The map opens on this area. Move and zoom the preview, then take what it shows, or frame all your locations. Only this area and a small border around it are loaded.
management.previewHint: Shows your current settings and updates on its own. Pan and zoom for another area.
management.previewEmpty: As soon as the map has a location or a data layer, it appears here and updates with every change.
management.allowPublic: Make this map available on the public website
management.publicHint: Private maps are visible only to website editors. Public maps are shown on published pages as they were at the last release: changes go live when you publish.
management.publishPermission: Only people who may publish can change whether a map is public.
management.failed: The map could not be loaded or saved. Check your permissions, settings, and data sources, then try again.
management.conflict: Someone else changed this map. Reload before saving to avoid overwriting their work.
management.createDescription: Mark public buildings or show geographic data. Then place the map on a page in the page editor.
management.editDescription: Change content and appearance. The preview shows your current settings.
management.inUseDescription: {count, plural, one {One map block still shows} other {# map blocks still show}} this map. Choose another map there or remove the block; then it can be deleted.
management.usageUnknown: Whether a page shows this map could not be checked. It is checked again before deleting.
management.searchAddressHint: Type at least three characters and pick a result.
management.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this. Only people who may publish can change or delete public maps.
management.liveDescription: No page places it in the editor any more, but the live site still shows it on: {pages}. Publish your changes first; then it can be deleted.
management.previewFailed: The preview could not be updated. The last preview stays visible.
management.searchUnavailable: Address search is not set up for this installation. Add locations manually and enter their coordinates.
management.locationDescriptionHint: Shown when a visitor selects this location.
management.locationLinkHint: Where selecting this location leads when the map opens links, e.g. https://example.org/library or /contact.
management.linkInvalid: Enter a web address (https://…), a page of this site (/contact), or an email or phone link.
management.colorByHint: Points of one value share a colour, and the legend explains them. Automatic picks a fitting attribute such as the category or status.
management.sizeByHint: Larger circles for larger numbers, e.g. a measured value. Automatic uses the value if the data has one.
management.showDetails: Show details when a point is selected
management.showDetailsHint: Visitors see the description and link you entered for a location, or the fields of a dataset. Without it, points are only drawn.

picker.failed: Maps could not be loaded. Open the list again to retry.
